subject: Clarifying PO Validation Rules + MSA Exception for Portal Onboarding
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@novamed.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Portal onboarding questions + PO field validation

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the walk-through earlier. We're trying to complete vendor activation in Ariba but are hitting two issues during PO creation that block EDI routing into our ERP: 

1) PO validation fails if the buyer attribute 'BU_ID' is missing from the order payload. Our procurement system populates BU_ID only for corporate purchases, not for some clinical sites.
2) Invoice matching rules require purchaser name + exact PO number; NovaMed sometimes sends PO numbers prefixed with the facility code (e.g., FAC123-PO456).

Separately, our procurement team asked whether Redwood will accept a limited MSA exception for invoice matching on onboarding customers that use our centralized billing (EFT). They want to avoid an immediate redline to the MSA if operationally we can support a mapping/translation step in the portal.

Can you confirm: 
- Which Order Form fields are mandatory during Ariba registration?
- Whether Redwood can map incoming buyer attributes to contract fields (BU_ID -> cost_center) or apply a PO prefix normalization rule?

Attaching a screenshot of the error and our current OrderForm export.

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaMed Health
---
Attachments: NovaMed_error_screenshot.png (image), NovaMed_OrderForm_v2.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding questions + PO field validation

Hi Karen —

Appreciate the details and the screenshot. Short answers up front: we can make Order Form fields optional or required per customer mapping, and we have a PO-normalization layer (we call it PO prefix strip) that can be enabled for a given account. That said, any contract-level changes (MSA exceptions) need legal sign-off.

Next steps I suggest: 
- Marissa, can you review the attached OrderForm and confirm which fields we currently require in Ariba enrollment for a standard enterprise onboarding?
- Olga, can you confirm whether Legal is comfortable approving a temporary operational exception (allowing prefix normalization + mapping BU_ID -> cost_center) that we document in the onboarding checklist instead of amending the MSA? If not, advise on the minimum redline wording.

Karen — I'll also route this to our integration team to capture the exact validation error and propose a mapping rule. If you can share a sample EDI/PO payload (sanitized), that will speed things up.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0182

Forwarding our internal notes and proposed redlines for the Order Form and onboarding flow. See attached MSA redlines (conservative edits) and a short implementation plan below.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed OrderForm/Portal tweaks for NovaMed
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Summary of implementation plan (ops + integration):
- Make BU_ID non-mandatory in Ariba enrollment and map BU_ID -> cost_center in Redwood's onboarding translator.
- Enable PO prefix normalization (strip leading FAC\d{3}- pattern) for the NovaMed account.
- Add a one-time onboarding validation step: procurement team to provide 5 sample POs to verify mapping.
- Add a procurement checklist item documenting the normalization rule and showing example transformations.

Legal posture / redline ask: 
- We propose documenting the normalization & mapping as an onboarding operational addendum (not an MSA amendment). The addendum states Redwood will perform mapping for a 90-day pilot period; if invoice reconciliation issues persist, parties will escalate per Section 7 of the MSA.

Please review the attached MSA_redlines_logan_20270521.docx for the exact language. If Legal wants to avoid any wording in writing, we can alternatively capture the agreement in the onboarding checklist and require sign-off from NovaMed procurement + Redwood CS director.

Karen — can you confirm whether procurement is comfortable with the 90-day pilot approach? If yes, we'll prepare the onboarding addendum and a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@novamed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying PO Validation Rules + MSA Exception for Portal Onboarding

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear summary, Marissa. I've reviewed the proposed language in MSA_redlines_logan_20270521.docx and the operational approach. Legal is comfortable with a narrowly scoped onboarding addendum (not an MSA amendment) on the following conditions: 

1) The addendum must explicitly limit the normalization/mapping to the onboarding pilot (90 days) and include acceptance criteria (five validated POs with zero reconciliation failures).
2) NovaMed procurement must acknowledge in writing that normalization may alter incoming PO text (we recommend an example mapping table attached).
3) We will log the exception in our contract exceptions tracker and attach a CS-approved rollback plan if reconciliation fails.

If those three items are acceptable, we will prepare a one-page onboarding addendum and circulate via DocuSign today. Sample language I recommend including: 
"Redwood may perform non-destructive PO normalization and field mapping during a limited onboarding period to facilitate portal enrollment. Such activities are operational in nature and do not modify the terms of the MSA; if reconciliation failures arise, the parties shall follow the dispute resolution path in Section 9.2."

Logan/Marissa — please add the addendum and the five-sample-PO checklist to the onboarding task in the integration ticket. Karen — are you able to route five anonymized POs to procurement@redwood.com by end of day Thursday (2027-05-27)?

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
